Frequently Asked Questions

How do I book a wash?

You can easily book a wash by visiting our website and selecting the desired service.

What payment methods do you accept?

We accept various payment methods including credit cards, debit cards, and e-wallets.

How long does the wash take?

The wash duration depends on the service you choose. Check our website for specific times.

Do you offer delivery?

Yes, we offer delivery to your home or office. Select the delivery option during booking.

What if I need to cancel?

You can easily cancel your booking up to 24 hours before the scheduled time. Check our cancellation policy on the website.

What are your operating hours?

Our operating hours are from 8 AM to 6 PM, Monday through Friday. Check our website for weekend and holiday schedules.

Frequently Asked Questions

What services does the laundry mat offer?

The laundry mat provides various services including washing, drying, and ironing.

How can I book a service at the laundry mat?

You can book a service by visiting our website or calling us directly.

What is the opening hours of the laundry mat?

The laundry mat operates from 9 AM to 5 PM, Monday through Friday.

Is there parking available at the laundry mat?

Yes, we provide free parking for our customers.

How do I pay for my services?

Payments can be made using cash, credit card, or debit card at the time of service.
